question: Q-W-C1-P
text: Revenue share by stock group for FY2015, with a grand total equal to total revenue.
interpretation: FY2015 revenue share by stock group (REV(g) / FY2015 revenue) plus the deduplicated total row equal to FY2015 revenue.
assemble: SELECT grain, stock_group_name, revenue, share FROM ( SELECT 'group' AS grain, stock_group_name, revenue, share FROM groups WHERE lines > 0 AND stock_group_name IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'total', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), revenue, share FROM total WHERE lines > 0 ) r ORDER BY grain, stock_group_name NULLS FIRST
note: Group rows sum each line into every group of its item (relationship through the bridge); the total row is the same measure without Stock Group, which Tableau answers without the bridge (deduplicated).
